tde_scope.presentation: Keep PDU-only current control distinct from possible future crate-status and external-inhibit interfaces.

presentation_exclusions: SC–OPC UA server deployment details in the main talk; original service figure retained in backup 23 at user request
current_architecture.lv_supply_control: SNMP control/status between DPS PLC and LV power supplies, grouped with PDUs. Documented BDE/PL506 TTL enable/inhibit inputs remain additional hardware protection interfaces.
current_architecture.device_control_protocol: SNMP for both PDUs and WIENER LV power supplies
current_architecture.rack_infrastructure: Rack/enclosure, feeds, PDU(s), smoke/humidity sensors and sensor support/power/relay/wiring; temperature/leak where fitted. Count once and map subsystem loads to outlets. No humidity shutdown rule is inferred.
current_architecture.ffdg_route: ISD proposes Metasys API in Batavia → DUNE FD SC → DPS. SBN API/OPC UA exercise reported by Manuel; live data awaits licence.
current_architecture.sdsta_route: Survey and agreement work ongoing; controller models, I/O, exported states and protocols under investigation. Intended information route enters SC.
current_architecture.cryo_route: Cryogenics is in the CUC. Internal control divisions appear as one system interface to SC and DPS. Run-state agreement remains open.
current_architecture.pof_monitoring: 4 laser-voltage readings + 1 chassis temperature per box, confirmed by Manuel
current_architecture.pof_inhibition: DPS → SNMP → PDU → PoF AC power. Additional local box-enable/inhibit is optional if an interface is available.
current_architecture.daphne_control: DPS ↔ SC ↔ OPC UA interface ↔ DAPHNE ZMQ control/status; DAQ CCM/opmon shares OPC UA; DAQ Hermes retains distinct IPBus/UDP route.
current_architecture.daphne_power: DPS ↔ SNMP ↔ WIENER LV supply → DAPHNE 48 V; PDS LV scope remains 34 feeds.
current_architecture.dps_logic: Proposed per-load permits, valid input handling, trip latches, actuator/readback and separate reset/re-enable on a commercial BDE-based PLC.
